property_summary: For any account and token id, calling balanceOf(account, id) on the reference contract never returns a value when account == address(0) because the call reverts (the zero-address is invalid), whereas the mutant allows balanceOf(address(0), id) to succeed and return a (possibly non-zero) stored balance, breaking the invariant that balanceOf reverts for the zero address.
change_summary: Change the zero-address check to allow zero address and return balance (removes revert on zero address).
